purpose: Evidence for the project owner to sign off, or not, on batch 3 of Milestone 5 Phase 1b: ten events built from the next ten releases that stand (reports/m5-phase1b-batch3-permission-2026-10-10.json), after a sealed dry run. Nothing here is an acceptance: every event stays quarantined, and no label is computed, until the owner's attestations are added. No event carries a call for the owner this time (decisions_needed is empty): the identity check found no listing or charter item in any of the ten histories, and no separate same-day release was found. The packet proposes label caveats for five filings inside windows and records one cash dividend (CXT).

dry_run.result: All ten events ran with no attestation and quarantined on FIRST_PUBLIC_TIME_UNVERIFIED with every session present and none at zero volume; CXT listed one cash dividend and the other nine no corporate action; the nineteen pins of batches 1 and 2 matched again.

signoff_items_requested.corporate_actions: Accept two signals: no Item 3.03 or 5.03 8-K in the archived history up to the window end, and Alpaca's real answer as the sealed dry run reported it (CXT one cash dividend, the other nine none).
